name: YK-11
lead: YK-11 is an experimental steroid-based compound classed as a SARM, though it behaves as a partial androgen receptor agonist. Research is confined to cell studies, mainly from Japanese groups in 2011 to 2013.
It is sold as a research chemical. No human trials exist.

paras: In cultured muscle cells it increased follistatin expression and reduced myostatin signalling via androgen receptor activation. These results have not been shown in humans.
Not approved and banned in sport. Safety is untested in humans, and liver, hormonal and cardiovascular effects are suspected. Products sold online are frequently mislabelled.

studies.title: Selective androgen receptor modulator, YK11, regulates myogenic differentiation of C2C12 myoblasts by follistatin expression
